name: myhealth checkup
description: Live, independent comparison of UK private blood tests and cancer screening: prices with published fees, full biomarker lists, sample methods, turnaround and provider accreditation. Ordered by price. Providers cannot pay to rank.
instructions: Live comparison data for UK private blood tests and cancer screening from myhealth checkup (myhealthcheckup.co.uk). Quote total_expected_cost_gbp as the price to pay where it differs from price_gbp, and give the last_checked_at date with any price. Add-on tests (is_addon: true) cannot be bought on their own. Treat prices with price_check_stale: true as out of date. compare_biomarker returns other_possible_matches; mention them when the user's term could mean more than one biomarker. Tell users to confirm the final price on the provider's page. This data compares tests. It is not medical advice, and myhealth checkup is not a medical provider.

tools.name: search_tests
tools.title: Search private blood tests
tools.description: Search live UK private blood tests and cancer screening tests. Returns the headline price and the total expected cost in GBP (adding the published collection fee for clinic-only tests), the full biomarker list, sample method, home kit or clinic options, turnaround and a direct link to the provider page, each with the date the price was last checked. Ordered by total expected cost unless you choose another sort.

search.description: Words in the test name, for example 'thyroid', 'vitamin d', 'well woman'.

category.description: Category slug, for example general-health, vitamins, hormones, thyroid, heart, mens-health, womens-health, cancer-screening, fertility, diabetes, gut. Call list_categories for the full list.

provider.description: Provider id or name, for example 'medichecks', 'randox', 'Goodbody Clinic'. Call list_providers for the list.

max_cost.description: Highest total expected cost in GBP.

collection.description: Only tests you can take with a home kit, or only tests with a clinic visit.

include_addons.description: Include add-on tests that must be bought with a base test. Default false.

sort.description: Default price (lowest total expected cost first).

tools.name: get_test
tools.title: Get one test
tools.description: Full record for one test by id (from search_tests): cost breakdown, every listed biomarker, the biomarkers we have matched to our biomarker library, sample method, turnaround and provider link.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: UK private testing providers we compare, with legal name, Companies House number where known, accreditation findings from public registers (UKAS, CQC, MHRA) with the date we checked them, number of tests and price range.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: Test categories with the number of live tests and providers in each.

tools.name: list_biomarkers
tools.title: List biomarkers
tools.description: Biomarkers we compare across providers, with synonyms, how many providers and tests measure each one, and the cheapest standalone test price. Use it to find the right biomarker name before calling compare_biomarker.

search.description: Part of a biomarker name, abbreviation or synonym, for example 'b12', 'cholesterol', 'tsh'.

min_providers.description: Only biomarkers offered by at least this many providers. Default 1.

tools.name: compare_tests
tools.title: Compare a test across providers
tools.description: Compare a named test across providers and find the lowest total expected cost. Matches on test name, so similar names can hide different biomarker lists; check biomarkers.count or use compare_biomarker for a like-for-like comparison.

q.description: Test name, for example 'vitamin d', 'thyroid', 'full blood count'.

tools.name: compare_biomarker
tools.title: Compare one biomarker across providers
tools.description: Every live test and provider that measures one biomarker, cheapest first, with the cheapest standalone test and the cheapest add-on per provider. This compares like with like even when providers name their tests differently.

biomarker.description: Biomarker name, abbreviation, synonym or id, for example 'ferritin', 'HbA1c', 'PSA', 'vitamin d'.

include_addons.description: Include add-on tests. Default true; they are labelled.

tools.name: find_tests_by_biomarkers
tools.title: Find one test for several biomarkers
tools.description: Find single tests that measure all of the biomarkers you list from one sample, cheapest first, plus the cheapest standalone test for each biomarker. If no single test covers them all, returns the tests that cover the most.

biomarkers.description: Two to ten biomarker names, for example ['ferritin', 'vitamin d', 'hba1c']. A comma-separated string also works.
